about: Lamort de Gail family tree. Each person: g = given name(s), sn = surname as shown on the card (children inherit it when omitted), full = full name, d = dates, st = rec (public records) | unc (unclear or conflicting), default family sources; src = keys into sources (default: wall); facts = notes. Each family: p and s = the couple, c = children, anchor = s when the spouse is the blood relative, uc = uncertain link to the parents, csn = surname the children take, fold = folded in the default view.
